dedupe_keys.name: hierarchical demand forecasting benchmark for the distribution grid

description: Hierarchical Demand Forecasting Benchmark for the Distribution Grid is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors , Lorenzo, , Vasco (Nespoli). This dataset contains power measurements and meteorological forecasts relative to a set of 24 power meters located in Rolle (Switzerland). These datasets are published to provide a standard benchmark for evaluating forecasting algorithms for demand side management applications. In L.Nespoli, V. Medici, K. Lopatichki, F. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
